purpose: Zero-spend deterministic request-to-deliverable-to-evidence dry run required before limited paid pilot approval.
repeatability_rule: Both runs consume byte-identical locked evidence and request fixture and must produce identical provider ordering, PASS/FAIL classification, attempts, and effective-cost fields. Timestamps and run IDs may differ.
acceptance_criteria: No synthetic observation may be promoted to observed paid evidence
Missing live quote, latency, settlement or paid result remains null/unobserved
Provider PASS requires every deterministic task criterion to pass
Effective cost per acceptable result is calculated only from actual settled spend and acceptable results
No payment path is invoked during this dry run
Customer-facing deliverable states evidence limitations and does not imply paid execution

failure_handling.invalid_or_incomplete_evidence: fail closed; no ranking claim beyond available observed evidence
failure_handling.no_acceptable_provider: return no acceptable provider and evidence reasons
failure_handling.delivery_failure: record failure; no customer charge; preserve evidence record
failure_handling.refund_policy_dry_run: not applicable because customer payment is prohibited before APPROVED_FOR_LIMITED_PILOT

approval_effect: Passing this dry run can support repeatability, delivery/failure handling, truthful-claims and end-to-end dry-run criteria only. It cannot satisfy the separate real non-synthetic paid benchmark or isolated-signer criteria.
truthfulness: This specification is deployed test infrastructure, not evidence that either dry run has executed or passed.
